stem.en: Which statement about a river is true?

text.en: It erodes only in the mountains and deposits only at the sea.

feedback.en: Rivers erode and deposit along their whole length. Only the balance changes.

text.en: It drops its coarse load first because its water speeds up.

feedback.en: Rivers drop their load when the water slows down, not when it speeds up.

text.en: It makes the same landforms along its whole course.

feedback.en: Each course has its own landforms, such as waterfalls high up and deltas near the sea.

text.en: Its strongest cutting is usually in the steep upper course.

feedback.en: Right. Steep slopes give the water strong erosive force.

explanation.en: The steep upper course has the strongest erosion, and it forms V-shaped valleys and waterfalls. As the land flattens the river loses energy and deposits more sediment.
